[LGRA.5.7.1] **A field type must resolve.** The type in a
`name: type` field declaration must resolve in the type namespace
([LGRA.22.7]): a builtin type, a declared unit symbol, dimension or
scalar-group name ([LUNI.7.1]), or a declared schema. The compiler must
refuse one that resolves to none of these, naming the slot and the
unresolved type (`DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_TYPE`). A service kwarg's type
resolves the same way ([LGRA.23.2]).
